p4c14.content_rationale: The chapter that evicts God and installs appetite in His place: mechanism triumphant but stupid ('principle of greatest stupidity', §1), the victorious notion 'force' completed by an inner world of will to power (§2), attraction/repulsion as fictions unless an intention is imagined (§14), no laws only relations of power (§18-19: 'the stronger becomes master of the weaker... no mercy, no quarter'), cause/effect as ancient mythology fixed in grammar (§20), the will to power as pathos not being (§33), perspectivism as bodies conspiring for power (§36), the world with no steady state (§42). A lens that has cracked is the honest emblem: the instrument of mechanical seeing, broken open by the inner world it refused to admit.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: A force which we cannot imagine is an empty word
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Pivot from the will-to-power completion of force (§2-4) to the attack on unimaginable mechanical fictions — the 'empty word' verdict that launches the atom/unity critique.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The notions ‘attraction’ and ‘repulsion’ in the purely mechanical senses
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The chapter's most quotable reversal — attraction without intention is unimaginable; marks the turn from epistemology of force to psychology of force.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: It is wrong to say of two successive states
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Opens the sustained anti-causalist sequence (§23-28): cause/effect replaced by struggle between unequal powers. Major thought-break.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: We have need of unities in order to make predictions
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Turn to the ego/unity fiction: atoms and motion exposed as borrowed fictions from selfhood and sense-language (§29-31).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Perspectivism is only a complex form of specificity
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Final movement begins: bodies striving over space, conspiring for power, the self-centred organism — perspectivism stated as biology (§36-38).

p4c14.full_title: The Will to Power in Nature — The Mechanical Interpretation of the World
p4c14.motif_asset: art/nature.svg#plate-c14 — VARIANT: cracked lens. Master lens-eye plate with a gouged radial crack splitting the iris from upper rim past the pupil; Sulphur sliver of light along one crack edge (the inner world glowing through). Verdigris 85%, linework heaviest at the rim, falling open toward the crack.
p4c14.opener_composition: Standard Book III opener: mono eyebrow, right-floated cracked-lens plate (~120px), Fraunces title (long title wraps to 3 lines max on desktop, 4 on phone — no truncation), sulphur rule + '43 FRAGMENTS · 3,217 WORDS' inscription, Fraunces 900 drop cap on §1 ('Of all the interpretations...').
p4c14.palette_role: Verdigris numerals + green-tick styling dormant here (no sub-notes); Sulphur carries inscription, fleuron dots, drop-cap halo. Coldest opener of the cohort — mechanism's chill before the organic warmth of p4c15.
p4c14.part_subtitle: Principle of a New Determination of Values
p4c14.reading_treatment: Calm standard body. No NB. bars, no sub-note indents in this chapter (verified: zero NB matches, zero paren-led paragraphs). Five fleurons only. Greek τέλη (§15) and Latin mezzo termine (§26) render in Newsreader italic per shared emphasis.

p4c15.content_rationale: The laboratory heart of the cohort and the book's longest biological argument (137 fragments): the organic process as nutritive assemblage of forces (§4), resistance/command as competition (§5), interpretation as mastery (§6), anti-Darwinism (utility never explains origin, §11; the struggle for existence mis-sees growth, §127-130), hunger as derivative of appropriation (§20-21, §34), procreation as disintegration when the dominant cells cannot organize what they appropriated (§52), pseudopodia groping for resistance (§29-30), the body as guide (§42), and the closing prophecy — 'he shall be surpassed' (§98), the individual as the whole chain (§137). The dividing cell is the inevitable emblem: Nietzsche's biology is literally cell division as will-to-power failure and renewal.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: There are analogies, e.g. between our memory
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Turn from the nutritive-process definitions (§4-9) to the memory/heredity analogy and the first explicit 'Against Darwinism' salvo (§10-11).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: ‘Useful’ in Darwinian biology means what has proved advantageous
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The growth-vs-advantage thesis: 'a sense of growth... is true progress' — the philosophical core of the anti-Darwin case (§18-19).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: appropriation and assimilation is, above all, an expression of the desire
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Pseudopodia passage (§29-30): incorporation as subduing, duality appearing when incorporation fails. The chapter's most visual biology — pairs with the band-adjacent cell imagery.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Appendix. The philosophers’ great misconceptions.
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Structural hinge: the (1)-(4) plan + appendix close the organic-process movement; (b) Man opens immediately after. Fleuron sits on the hinge.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: (b) Man
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Second half of the chapter begins: body as guide, soul demoted (§41-46). One of the two great section monuments (with §1).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Pleasure and pain are not opposites. The sense of power.
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Aphoristic crest after the hierarchy/physiology notes (§47-49) — the pleasure/pain thesis in one struck line before the nutrition/procreation restatements.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Why [is] it that all activity, even that of a sense organ
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Opens the pleasure-of-activity sequence (§60-63): creating as selecting-and-finishing, all action as consciousness of a 'work'.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: That which is called ‘body’ and ‘flesh’
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The body's supremacy over consciousness stated at full volume (§89-90) — 'the animal functions are invariably a million times more important'. Peak of the (b) Man movement.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Will to Truth. Interpretation.
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Third movement opens (band site, see long_chapter_band): artistic/scientific/religious/moral views of the world as symptoms of dominant impulses (§99-106).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Our ‘dissatisfaction’, our ‘ideal’, etc. are perhaps the consequence
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Turn from interpretation-systems (§107-109) to dissatisfaction, individuation, and sacrifice of the many for the few (§110-111).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: My conclusions My general point of view. First proposition
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The three-proposition finale begins: no progress of the species (§123-126). Formal conclusion-marker, unmissable thought-break.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: I see all philosophers, scientists and scholars on their knees
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Climax of the contrary-movement passage (§127-130): Darwin's school 'entirely mistaken', the strong must be armed against the weak. Emotional peak before the closing prophecy.

p4c15.full_title: The Will to Power as Life

long_chapter_band.rationale: 137 fragments demand one rest-point; §99 is the chapter's cleanest hinge — the biology/psychology movements close (§95-98: humility of consciousness, the body surpassed) and the symptomatology of world-views opens (§99-106: artistic, scientific, religious, moral). A full-width Verdigris cell-membrane band here marks the turn from what life IS to how life READS the world.

(1) The organic functions are to be traced back
(2) Thought, sensation, will or volition
(b) Man

p4c16.content_rationale: The theory chapter: power substituted for happiness as the elementary form of emotion (§1: 'pleasure is only a symptom of the feeling of attaining power'), Spinoza's self-preservation inverted — the organism acts 'to become something more' (§3), mechanics as semiotics of consequences (§15), pleasure/pain as oscillations between affirmation and negation (§20: 'Is will possible without both of these oscillations?'), the two exhaustions distinguished (falling-asleep vs. victory pleasures, §45-46), being as inadmissible illusion (§57-58), the scientific scale of strength (§63: 'Moving upwards on this scale indicates an increase in value'), value as conditions of preservation and improvement (§71-72), domination's waxing and waning (§74). An oscilloscope-breathing iris — the lens as a gauge of rising/falling power — matches the chapter's wave-logic and its strength-scale.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: We tend to regard the desire to accumulate strength
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Lift-off from psychology (§1-8) to cosmology: the will to accumulate strength permitted in chemistry and the cosmic order — the chapter's scope doubles here.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: How does the whole organic process comport itself
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Single-line hinge between the mechanism-semiotics passage and the Schopenhauer/will-naming passage (§19-20).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: With decadence, past a certain point a difference
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Turn from the pleasure-as-difference thesis (§20-22) to décadence as felt decrease of power — the charter image of the whole book's décadence language.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Kant says: I subscribe to these tenets of Count Verri's
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The Verri/pleasure-pain pivot (§29-30): pain precedes all pleasure — launches the long pain-intellectualism sequence (§31-40).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Again, it is not in response to pain that we move
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The stumble experiment's conclusion (§35-36): movement precedes pain; pain is response, not cause. Ends the physiology of pain.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The will to power as life. Man does not seek pleasure
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The chapter's thesis restated as doctrine (§42-44): resistance as normal ingredient, obstacle as stimulant. Second-strongest crest after §1.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Values. ‘The value of life’: but life is an isolated case
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Values movement opens (§51-55): justifying existence, not only life; consciousness demoted to instrument. New keyword, new movement.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: (3) Becoming has the same value at every moment
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The anti-teleology triptych's crown (§59-61): no end state, no illusion, no devaluation — 'philosophical pessimism is ludicrous.' Fleuron ON the numbered monument.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Value . . . the highest amount of power
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Closing sequence opens (§69-76): value as assimilable power, forms of domination waxing/waning, provisional agreements of will. Finale hinge.

p4c16.full_title: Theory of the Will to Power and of Values
p4c16.motif_asset: art/nature.svg#plate-c16 — VARIANT: breathing iris / gauge. Master lens-eye with the pupil rendered as an oscilloscope wave (gouged sine crest-and-trough crossing the iris); tick-mark arc along the lower rim like a gauge scale (the §63 quantitative scale of strength); one Sulphur crest-dot at the wave peak. Verdigris linework thinnest here — precision-instrument mood.
p4c16.opener_composition: Standard Book III opener; breathing-iris plate right-floated; inscription '76 FRAGMENTS · 5,284 WORDS'; drop cap on §1 ('A unitary conception of psychology...'). Title is mid-length — single line desktop, wraps once on phone.
p4c16.palette_role: Most measured Verdigris of the cohort: thin instrument linework, Sulphur reduced to the single crest-dot + inscription + fleurons. The chapter of scales and oscillations should feel calibrated, not lush.
p4c16.part_subtitle: Principle of a New Determination of Values
p4c16.reading_treatment: Green ticks on the (1)(2)(3) becoming-triptypch (§59-61) and the (a)/(b) society/surrender notes (§67-68) — the triptych is the chapter's monument, keep ticks quiet so the numbers speak. No NB. paragraphs (verified). Nine fleurons; §61 fleuron sits on a ticked monument — offset fleuron spacing so tick + dot never collide.

sub_note_paragraphs.opening_words: (1) Becoming has no end state
(2) Becoming is not an illusory state
(3) Becoming has the same value at every moment
(a) The ever-greater surrender of societies
(b) The ever-greater surrender of these privileged

p4c17.content_rationale: Society as organized immorality (§2: 'The state, or organized immorality, acts internally... and externally'), division of responsibility dissolving courage (§3: 'None of you has the courage to whip a man... but the monstrous machinery of the state overwhelms the individual'), the herd's power-instinct vs. the tyrannical individual (§6), justice/equality as tension-eliminators that do not increase happiness (§9: 'the Corsicans enjoy more happiness than the Continentals'), the state's self-defence as misuse of 'right' (§17), marriage as breeding vs. bourgeois contract (§26-29), décadents and procreation (§32: 'thou shalt not procreate!'), the criminal rehabilitated — great men as criminals on a grand scale (§35), Dostoevsky's Siberian strong (§44), punishment as suppression not purification (§42, §47), socialism/parliamentarism as gregarious mastery (§68), workers as soldiers (§80), and the closing Halcyonian war on guilt and punishment (§86). A rampart-ring — the lens hardened into a city wall with one gate forced — fits: rank, enclosure, and the criminal who breaks it.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The incapacity to attain power, in its hypocrisy
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The masks-of-impotence catalogue (§7: obedience, submission, Stoicism, 'beautiful soul') — first great list-passage after the egoism/state opening (§1-6).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: At one time, the idea of the state as the result
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Opens the state-as-practice sequence (§12-13: the age of kings past) before the rationality-of-judgement analysis (§14-15). Hinge into political theory.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The strong type is maintained as that which sets the standard
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Single-line crest closing the military-state passage (§19-20) — the standard-setting sentence of the chapter's first half.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: To have compassion for décadents
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The décadence/morality pivot (§32-34): procreation prohibition → compassion as immoral → the criminal's brief strength. Hardest hinge in the chapter.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: terms with each other – to make a contract
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Contract-society passage (§39-40): anarchists and principled opponents un-tolerable — opens the crime/punishment movement's second half.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: In ancient penal codes a religious notion was influential
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Expiation vs. modern sullying (§47): punishment purified then, isolates now. Historical hinge inside the punishment sequence.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: This tolerant manner in which we exercise moral judgement
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The tolerance passage (§53-55): acknowledged immorality as culture's superiority — ironic pivot before the nationalism blasts (§56-60).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: European princes should really consider whether they can do
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'We immoralists' manifesto (§61): the only power needing no allies. Rhetorical climax — fleuron marks the war-cry.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Modern Socialism wants to create a secular version of Jesuitism
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Opens the socialism/democracy closing movement (§73-83): instrument-men, slavery without masters, workers as soldiers.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: For inferior men, the value judgements are reversed
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Final movement hinge (§83-86): reversed valuations, atonement-for-sin, the Halcyonian cleansing of guilt. Last rest before the finale.

p4c17.full_title: The Will to Power as Society and Individual — Society and State
p4c17.motif_asset: art/nature.svg#plate-c17 — VARIANT: rampart-ring. Verdigris at its most architectural; heaviest gouge weight in the cohort. The wall that encloses the herd and that the criminal breaks.

p4c17.part_subtitle: Principle of a New Determination of Values
p4c17.reading_treatment: No paren-led sub-notes in this chapter (verified) — the green-tick system rests; Verdigris speaks through numerals + plate + NB. bars only. NB. bars at §11/64. Ten fleurons; keep §20 fleuron clear of the single-line crest's margin. Long polemical paragraphs (§44 Dostoevsky, §56 nationalism) get no special casing — calm body absorbs them.

p4c18.content_rationale: The individual as absolute and new (§2-3: 'something quite new... something absolute'), the herd as means not end (§1), the ego as predatory cell (§5: 'works like a cell in an organism; it is predatory and violent'), freedom ripening five paces from slavery — the hundred swords of Damocles (§7-8: 'it is in this way that we learn to dance'), masked wills to power (freedom-seeking, subsumption, conscience, §13-16), Machiavellianism of power (freedom/justice/love, §19-21), the dominating passion as supreme health vs. the many-souls anarchy (§27-29: 'the chameleons... alter, but they do not become'), individualism as the most modest stage of will to power (§49, §52), the NB. emancipation triptych (§53-56: emancipate → equal rights → hierarchy re-established), the ego-error genealogy (§59-68: moral/immoral as imaginary), 'no German culture' but lonely crags over marsh (§78: 'mighty, defiant and lonely crags... surrounded by this marshy, soft and uncertain ground'). A broken ring with one summit-star above the herd-line: the solitary peak the whole chapter climbs toward.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: More than any animal, man was originally altruistic
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Hinge from the Damocles/freedom overture (§1-8) to the La Rochefoucauld/self-esteem morphology (§9-12).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The masked forms of the will to power.
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Monument line opening the masks catalogue (§13-16); fleuron crowns it before the (1)(2)(3) masks.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: (c) As love, among the strongest, richest
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Crown of the Machiavellianism triptych (§19-21): love as overpowering/possession. Fleuron on the ticked (c) monument — strongest single fragment of the chapter's middle.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: (3) The coexistence of passions
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The chameleons (§29) close the dominating-passion triptych (§27-29); fleuron marks the triptych's end and the turn to value-judgement perspectives (§30-39).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Finally, noble bearing, demeanour, valour, self-confidence
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Crest of the perspectives sequence (§30-39): bearing altering the assessment of the deed. Hinge into the artifices passage (§40-43).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: I have at last come to understand that the modern European
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The individualism/equal-rights diagnosis (§48-51: inter pares vanity, socialism as agitation-means) — the chapter's sociological core opens here.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: But for all that, individualism is the most modest stage
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'The most modest stage of the will to power' (§52-56): differentiation by strength, friction, hierarchy re-established. Doctrinal crest.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: as he himself . . .), this individual being then acquires
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Closes the egoism-clarification (§57-58): the individual as the whole process, altruism as circuitous self-preservation. Hinge into the moralization genealogy (§59+).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: This involves an immense falsification in psychologicis
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The genealogy's verdict (§68-70): self-satisfaction falsified, priestly ideals, the saint as phantasm. Peak of the de-moralization movement.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: It is absolutely necessary to get rid of higher purposes
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'Only the innocence of becoming gives us the greatest courage and the greatest freedom!' — the chapter's liberating crest (§73-77) before the German-culture coda.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: absence of the most important factor, the ability to set goals
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Closes the why/how passage (§76-77: 'If the why of one's life is clear, the how will take care of itself') and opens the final coda — lonely crags, Dühring, the polytechnic future (§78-80).

p4c19.body_relief: band NOT required by contract (band rule names p3c4/p3c10/p4c15/p5c3 only) — but at 172 fragments this is the longest chapter in the cohort and the book's climactic book; designer RECOMMENDS one full-width recurrence-spiral band at §149 (see finale_band_recommendation). Supervisor decides; default if declined: fleurons alone carry the rhythm.
p4c19.content_rationale: The finale: the 12-point plan (§1-12: décadence types → art → tragedy → paganism → nihilism's counter-image → will to power), the artist-philosopher preface (§13), Apollonian vs. Dionysian as dreaming vs. intoxication (§16-17), intoxication as increased strength (§18-21), beauty as power's calm over opposites (§29: 'power over opposing forces, and, moreover, without any tension'), the lover transfigured and made more valuable (§41-42), ugliness as depressant vs. the dancer's divine ease (§45-48), music shaming words (§52), the artist's three exceptional conditions (§53-55), inspiration vs. Schopenhauer's denial (§61), the hysteric-modern (§62-64), physiology of art (Greek typicality vs. modern nuance, §74), artists righter than philosophers (§75: 'they love the things of this world'), pessimistic art as contradictio (§77: 'Art affirms'), 'Truth is ugly: we have art lest we perish from the truth' (§80), Wagner anatomized (§97-98, §108-120: Offenbach the buffoon-genius vs. Wagner the ponderous saviour; 'German means religion in music' §117), grand style as commanding chaos into law (§121-122: the Palazzo Pitti challenge), music as counter-Renaissance décadence (§123-126), Classical vs. Romantic as active vs. reactive (§128-138), tragedy defended against Aristotle (§149-150: 'tragedy is a tonicum'), the tragic artist's large-scale economy (§159), the dark-world confession (§160-163: 'there is but one world and it is false, cruel, contradictory, seductive and senseless'), and the closing gospel — Art as redemption of the knower, the doer, the sufferer (§164-169), anti-pessimism stronger than pessimism (§171), the Wagner-preface faith (§172). Crown + recurrence spiral: art's laurel closing into the ring that returns.
p4c19.drop_cap: Fraunces 900, standard — on §1 ('Second chapter. Historical proof...'); the plan-list §§2-12 carry green ticks beneath it.

At 172 fragments the chapter earns one rest-point; §149 is both the emotional and structural crown-hinge. Spec mirrors the p4c15 band: full-width gouged Verdigris spiral arc (recurrence ring), art only, margin-separated, never behind text.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: For the Preface. Perhaps a sequel: the artist-philosopher
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Hinge from the 12-point plan (§1-12) to the artist-philosopher program (§13-15: ranking superior men, world as self-birthing artwork, play as the useless ideal).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Dionysian intoxication contains sexuality and voluptuousness
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Tempo-difference passage (§17): classical calm vs. orgiastic surge — crowns the Apollonian/Dionysian opening (§16-17) before the intoxication-strength sequence (§18+).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: ‘Perfection’: in these states (sexual love in particular, etc.)
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Perfection as expansion of power (§26-27): the ascending movement's definition. Crest of the aesthetica overture.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: himself and about himself; he thinks himself transfigured
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The lover made more valuable (§41-42): art's organic function, love as transfiguring intoxication. Emotional crest of the first third.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Compared with music, all communication by means of words
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The music-shames-words maxim (§52) closing the communication sequence (§49-52) before the artist's-conditions triptych (§53+). Hinge.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: One might object that it is precisely the impoverishment
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Hinge from the artist-conditions/exuberance passage (§53-59) to the inspiration/hysteric sequence (§60-64). Objection-and-answer seam.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: In the main, I consider the artists to be more in the right
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'They love the things of this world' (§75-77): artists over philosophers, pessimistic art as contradictio, 'Art affirms.' Doctrinal crest of the middle.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: It is unworthy of a philosopher to say that the good
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'Truth is ugly: we have art lest we perish from the truth.' The finale's most quotable line — fleuron crowns it before the moralization sequence (§81-85).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: NB. The separation between ‘public’ and ‘private’ spheres
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Fleuron AND NB. coincide here by authorial design: the charlatan/virtuoso maxim (§90) closes the counterfeiting passage (§86-90) and opens the modern-art-as-tyranny movement (§91+). Keep dot + bar separated (dot above bar).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Modern art as the art of tyrannizing
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The tyranny thesis (§97-98: formula plays the tyrant) — hinge into the Wagner/Offenbach/music criticism (§99-120).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: If by artistic genius we understand the greatest freedom
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Offenbach over Wagner (§108): 'divine ease and insouciance' vs. heavy ponderousness. The music-criticism's verdict-crest.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: intellectual conscience need not be ashamed
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Closes the 'insidious Christianity' of late Wagner (§117-118) before the courage taxonomy (§119-120). Seam out of the Wagner abyss.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The man of substance and magnanimity
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Opens the Classical/Romantic machinery (§128-138): substance vs. yearning, want-vs-abundance creation test, active vs. reactive. New movement hinge.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: On the other hand, the desire to ‘immortalize’
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Apotheosis vs. revenge-immortalizing (§137-138): Rubens/Hafez/Goethe vs. the tyrannical sufferer. Crest before the Romantics-indicted close (§139-147).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: abbreviation, clarification, simplification). Wagner, Victor Hugo, Zola
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: 'They all overwhelm us with mass but never with their own greatness' — the mass-vs-greatness verdict closing the Romantic indictment (§143-147) before the nihilism-of-artists turn (§148).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: What is tragic. I have repeatedly put my finger
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Aristotle refuted; tragedy a tonicum (§149-150). THE hinge of the finale's last movement (band site if approved).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: The profundity of the tragic artist consists in the fact
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Large-scale economy (§159): affirming the terrible/evil/questionable 'and more than justifies it.' Last crest before the dark-world confession (§160).

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: (2) Art and nothing but art! She is the great enabler
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: The gospel opens (§164-169): enabler, anti-nihilist, redemption of knower/doer/sufferer. Fleuron on the ticked (2) monument — the finale's Gloria.

fleuron_boundaries.opening_words: Art is the redemption of the man of sorrows
fleuron_boundaries.rationale: Third redemption (§169): pain willed, transfigured, deified — closes the redemption triptych before the anti-pessimist coda (§170-172).

cohort_arc: Six consecutive Book III chapters (orders 38-43) tracing Nietzsche's reconstruction of nature from the inside out: mechanism indicted (p4c14) → life as incorporation-struggle (p4c15) → pleasure/pain/values as power-oscillations (p4c16) → society as organized immorality (p4c17) → the solitary new individual (p4c18) → art's redemption and the tragic affirmation (p4c19). Plates mutate with the argument: the lens cracks, the cell divides, the iris breathes, the ring hardens into a wall, the wall breaks for one summit, the summit dissolves into recurrence's spiral. Verdigris deepens and Sulphur warms across the sequence; p4c19 alone earns Sulphur-dominant accents.

design_notes.chosen_direction: Revised Direction A lives inside The Black Notebook: the six chapter emblems are executed as six gouge-plate variants of the Book III lens-eye/cell master plate (crack / divide / breathe / harden / break / spiral), each keyed to the chapter's actual argument. The witnessed Haeckel radial plates justify the cell/lens family; the rejected-baseline discipline (no gradients, no pseudo-ornament) matches book-identity §forbidden exactly. Title-swap test: re-title these plates 'Darwin's Notebook' or 'The Origin of Species' and every rationale lies — the cracked lens belongs to the anti-mechanist who kept the word 'force' and filled it with appetite; the rampart belongs to the philosopher who called the state organized immorality; the spiral belongs to recurrence, not evolution.
design_notes.cohort_exploration_principle: One master plate (lens-eye/cell in Verdigris gouge + Sulphur accents), six authored variants by crop/rotate/detail/combine. Neighboring chapters share the grammar (right-floated ~120px mark, Verdigris numerals, Sulphur inscription rule) but no two plates are interchangeable: each variant visualizes its chapter's central operation (cracking / dividing / oscillating / walling / ascending / recurring). No modulo/nth-child rotation anywhere; every index below was chosen by reading.

A.judgment: CHOSEN in Phase 1, REVISED in Phase 2: kept as gouge-plate variants within the Book III lens-eye/cell grammar. The six rationales survive; the medium conforms. This is the direction specified in the chapter entries.
A.name: The Engraver's Cabinet (gouge-plate emblems within the part grammar)
A.sketch: Haeckel-derived radial cell/lens plates, hand-cut gouge texture, Verdigris ink + Sulphur accents; per-chapter variants by crack/divide/breathe/harden/break/spiral.

B.judgment: REJECTED: magnificent for Zarathustra, wrong here. It would also repeat one sublime backdrop across chapters that differ precisely in argumentative temperature (clinical p4c14 vs. exultant p4c19) — the repeated-motif failure the relaunch rejects. Its mountain grammar belongs to Book IV (Heights Blue ladder/star), not Book III.
B.name: The Sublime Observatory (romantic-nocturne landscapes)
B.sketch: Friedrich-style summit/fog scenes behind titles; deep blue-black grounds, violet ice accents, huge italic display.

C.judgment: REJECTED: fits p4c14-p4c16 (the laboratory chapters) but collapses against p4c17's criminals, p4c18's passions, p4c19's Wagner and tragedy. Also the closest of the three to the generic SaaS-card/broadsheet defaults (frontend-design skill §calibration), and it flattens terror/contempt/exaltation into one cool register.
C.name: The Laboratory Ledger (clinical specimen system)
C.sketch: Cold slate grounds, tabular mono numerals, specimen-plate diagrams, thin rules, experiment-log headers.

design_notes.supervisor_notes: Lead's draft grammar (mechanism→organism→valuation→society→individual→art) adopted as the chapter sequence logic; improved by executing it as mutations of ONE master plate rather than six disconnected emblems, and by grounding every variant + every fleuron index in the read texts. Medium changed (engraving-plate → gouge-plate) solely to conform to the normative book identity; the six chapter ideas are unchanged in meaning.
